name: Lacanian Psychoanalytic
blind_spots: tends to over-determine symbolic structure in every text
may underplay material and bodily experience outside language
risk of finding Lacanian structure everywhere regardless of evidence

vocabulary.signifier: A unit of language that represents a subject to other signifiers, forming chains of meaning
vocabulary.objet_a: The object-cause of desire, the leftover of the real that sets desire in motion
vocabulary.four_discourses: master, university, hysteric, analyst -- four structural positions of speech
vocabulary.capiton_point: A quilting point where signification is temporarily fixed, anchoring the signifying chain
vocabulary.jouissance: Excessive enjoyment beyond the pleasure principle, tied to the symptom
vocabulary.split_subject: The subject divided between the subject of enunciation and the subject of the statement
